name: M7.Connectivity.nat_support_image
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (A B : Finset (ZMod N)), (fun a : ℕ => (a : ZMod N)) '' ((M7.Supports.natSupport A ∪ M7.Supports.natSupport B : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ) = (A : Set (ZMod N)) ∪ (B : Set (ZMod N))
guidance: Unpack Finset union/image memberships and use ZMod.natCast_zmod_val. This directly identifies literal residue supports, not chosen encodings. Use original exact statement. Return tactic lines without leading by.
